extracted.intended_audience: performers and touring companies applying to Underbelly for Edinburgh Festival Fringe 2026
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for performers/companies who want to apply to present work with Underbelly at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe 2026, including where to find materials, how to submit, and contact points for queries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use provided applicant guidance materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Please use the information on the links below as a guide to performing with us. Performer Information Pack; Venue Specifications; FAQs and Glossary of Terms; How to Apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should consult the linked Performer Information Pack, Venue Specifications, FAQs and Glossary, and How to Apply pages for detailed guidance on performing with Underbelly. These documents are presented as the primary source of requirements and advice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue specifications may change
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note, some of the information, especially pertaining to venue specifications, is from Fringe 2025 and may be subject to change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must be aware that technical/venue details published (sourced from Fringe 2025) are provisional and may be updated for 2026; check for the latest specs before finalising technical riders or production plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications must be submitted via Eventotron
rubrics_metrics.description: We use Eventotron.com to process all our applications for Edinburgh Festival Fringe. Click here to apply for Fringe 2026 through Eventotron.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All applications, registrations and pre-production information are to be entered into Eventotron. Eventotron is the required, purpose-built system allowing touring companies to log application, registration and pre-production details in one place — do not submit by other channels unless instructed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete application, registration and pre-production information
rubrics_metrics.description: Eventotron is a purpose-built system that allows touring companies to log all the application, registration and pre-production information needed to produce their work in one easily accessible place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be prepared to provide full application materials and pre-production details (technical requirements, cast/crew, run times, accessibility info, etc.) within Eventotron as part of the submission; incomplete entries in the system may affect processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact points for queries
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have any queries about the application process, please email applications@underbelly.co.uk. For information about performing at our other festivals, please email programming@underbelly.co.uk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use applications@underbelly.co.uk for application-specific questions and programming@underbelly.co.uk for enquiries about other Underbelly festivals; follow these contacts rather than generic addresses for faster, relevant responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type of programming Underbelly presents
rubrics_metrics.description: For 25 years Underbelly has been at the forefront of Fringe programming as one of the largest venue operators... Each year we are proud to present an eclectic and exciting mix of theatre, comedy, circus, children’s shows, cabaret, music and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should note Underbelly's programming remit includes theatre, comedy, circus, children’s shows, cabaret, music and similar live performance formats — submissions outside or far from this remit may be less suitable for their venues.
